note: content-visual-forge is an LLM-based skill without a CLI runner. Evals test cover-engine routing, template selection (knowledge-card / learning-card / social-card / character-card / cover-card), style-atlas consistency through prompt-based evaluation. Structural validation (id, files, expected_output) is the automated gate.

dimension_semantics.blind: manual: LLM judge evaluates if output matches expected_output
dimension_semantics.confusion_matrix: manual: categorize by cover / knowledge / social / character / learning
dimension_semantics.stability: manual: re-run eval with same prompt to check output consistency
